name: Crystal Fruit Greenhouse
description: A beautiful glass greenhouse cultivating exotic trees that bear fruits made of living crystal, with prismatic light reflections dancing across the glass panes.
prompt: A stunning Victorian glass greenhouse filled with exotic fruit trees whose fruits are made of living crystal—diamonds, rubies, emeralds, and sapphires hanging like ripe produce. Sunlight streams through the glass roof, creating prismatic reflections across every surface. Dewdrops on crystal fruits catch the light. Hyperrealistic, botanical wonder, 8k, cinematic lighting
caption: When nature meets the jewelry box! 💎🍎 This greenhouse grows the rarest fruits—ones you'd want to display, not eat! What's your favorite crystal fruit? The way the light dances through these edible gems is pure magic. Who needs a diamond pickaxe when you have a greenhouse like this?
